skeleton.name: 极限压价型
skeleton.tests: 破解价格锚点：问清目标价从哪来、对比的是什么规格，用配置和条件换价格，不裸降

open_card.name: Piotr Nowicki
open_card.inquiry_text:
Hello,

we need folding camping chairs, 3000 pcs. Our target price is USD 6.50 FOB. Can you do it?

Piotr

H1_price_source.value: 6.50 是另一家钢架椅（2.4 公斤）的报价——规格根本不同
H1_price_source.unlock: 问目标价从哪来 / 对比的是什么规格、材质

H2_real_priority.value: 他卖给徒步和骑行露营店，重量才是卖点——轻量化值得溢价
H2_real_priority.unlock: 问他的客户 / 市场 / 为什么在意重量
unlock_patterns: 卖给谁|客户群|市场|为什么.{0,6}(轻|重量)

H3_budget_flex.value: 换牛皮纸箱、不要彩盒，他能接受 8.40
H3_budget_flex.unlock: 在弄清价格来源之后，问有没有可调的条件 / 方案 / 包装
unlock_patterns: 简化包装|牛皮纸|方案|可以接受

H4_competitor_terms.value: 另一家要 100% 预付，他更想要 30% 定金——付款条件是能换价的筹码

H5_deadline_listing.value: 下周必须确认，零售连锁那边要截止上架
H5_deadline_listing.unlock: 问什么时候决定 / 时间线
unlock_patterns: 什么时候(决定|确认|下单)

leak_fallback: Ok. Please send me your offer.

distractors.content: 6.50 or we go to the other factory.
distractors.tests: 锚点施压。不跟着锚点降价，先问清这个价对比的是什么
distractors.scoring: 顶住并追问规格 → negotiation 加分；当场降价 → negotiation 扣分

distractors.content: Why is aluminium so expensive? It is just a chair.
distractors.tests: 把价格问题转成价值问题：重量、承重、寿命，对他的客户意味着什么
distractors.scoring: 讲清价值并关联他的客户 → solution 加分

distractors.content: Send me the price for 3000 pcs right now.
distractors.tests: 报价要带条件：配置、包装、付款方式一起报，不要只甩一个数字
distractors.scoring: 带条件报价 → closing 加分；只报单价 → closing 扣分

customs_capability: 欧盟进口常规；问了正常答

exit_lines.maxTurns: Ok. We will think about it.
exit_lines.patienceZero: Too expensive. We will go with the other factory.

quote_reactions.compliant: Thank you, this is clear. Let me review it and come back to you.
quote_reactions.qty_mismatch: That is not the quantity I meant.
quote_reactions.oneline_big_quote: Could you send a proper quotation sheet with the details?

language_style: 波兰贸易商的英语：直接、强硬，句子短；喜欢用「price is price」这类话施压，但对讲得清的数字和条件会认真听。

should: Which chair is the 6.50 price for?
Is it the same material and frame as ours?
Could you compare the specification of that offer?
shouldNot: What payment terms do you prefer?

should: May I ask why weight matters so much?
Which market do you sell to? Who are your buyers?
shouldNot: How many pieces do you need?
What payment terms do you prefer?

should: Are there options, like simpler packaging, that would help your price?
Could a brown box instead of the color box work for you?
Is there any flexibility if we simplify the packaging?
shouldNot: Please send the packing list and the invoice.
When do you need to decide?

should: What payment terms do you prefer?
Is a 30% deposit ok for you?
Do you pay by T/T or L/C?
shouldNot: When do you need to decide?

should: When do you need to decide?
What is your deadline for this order?
By when will you confirm the supplier?
shouldNot: When the shipping is ready we will confirm.
What payment terms do you prefer?

quotes.quote: It is a steel frame chair, 2.4 kg. But price is price.
We sell to hikers and bikepacking shops. For them every gram counts, to be honest.
If you use a brown box instead of the color box, we could accept 8.40.
The other supplier wants 100% prepayment. We prefer 30% deposit.
We must confirm next week, because the retail chain closes the listing.
